g10-geography-ug7-t1.overview: Unplanned Urbanization sits inside Geographic Issues and Public Concerns in Africa. Geographic issues in Africa are the focus of Unit 7 of Grade 10 Geography in the Ethiopian (FDRE Ministry of Education) curriculum. First, it explains unplanned urbanization and why African cities grow faster than their services. Then it sets out the slums, weak infrastructure, and health and social strains that follow. Next, it analyzes migration, its push and pull factors, and its internal and international forms. Also it examines coastal pollution, from sewage and industrial waste to plastic on the beaches. Students will also learn how geographic issues in Africa apply to real-life situations, such as housing, jobs, and clean water.
objectives: Explain the causes and consequences of unplanned urbanization in Africa.
Analyze the push and pull factors of migration in Africa.
Describe internal and international migration and their impacts.
Identify the sources and effects of coastal pollution.
Compare the geographic issues in Africa that most affect its people.
